requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver starts the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the start key 0x0000CCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field is written with value 0xCCCC.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver refreshes the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the refresh key 0x0000AAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field is written with value 0xAAAA.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver enables write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the enable key 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field is written with value 0x5555.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver disables write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write a key value other than 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field is written with a value different from 0x5555 (e.g., 0x00000000).
